On the design and properties of porous femoral stems with adjustable stiffness gradient.

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem pubmed Direct Read now simulation_case
Su Wang, Xin Zhou, Linlin Liu, Zhang'ao Shi, Yongqiang Hao Medical engineering & physics 2020-07-01 10.1016/j.medengphy.2020.05.003
单位: School of Mechanical Engineering Sichuan University, Chengdu, Sichuan 610065, China.
通讯: Xin Zhou @ School of Mechanical Engineering Sichuan University, Chengdu, Sichuan 610065, China. Electronic address: 845708996@qq.co
相关性: 该论文直接研究多孔股骨柄的应力遮挡、微动及骨整合，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
边界: The paper lacks experimental validation and patient-specific modeling, relying solely on finite element simulation.
动机· 减小股骨柄与骨之间的模量差异导致的应力遮挡。
方法· 使用金刚石晶格结构设计多孔股骨柄，通过有限元分析评估不同孔隙率和梯度。
结果· 轴向和径向梯度多孔柄可显著降低骨密度损失。
验证· 有限元模拟，无实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To reduce stress shielding caused by the modulus mismatch between femoral stem and bone.
Method· Designed porous femoral stems with diamond lattice structure and evaluated homogeneous and graded porosity using finite element analysis.
Result· Axial and radial graded stems reduced bone density loss by approximately 74% compared to fully dense stems.
Validation· Finite element simulation without experimental validation.

相关性: 该论文研究生物活性PEEK复合材料用于3D打印，但未涉及LPBF、疲劳测试或应力遮挡分析。
边界: No LPBF fabrication, no fatigue testing, no stress shielding analysis, no porous structure evaluation.
动机· 开发可3D打印的生物活性PEEK复合材料用于骨植入。
方法· 熔融共混AMP与PEEK制成丝材，进行流变、体外和体内评价。
结果· AMP-PEEK复合材料显示出增强的生物活性和骨整合能力。

Motivation· To develop bioactive and osseointegrable PEEK-based composite filaments for 3D printing of dental and orthopedic implants.
Method· AMP-PEEK filaments were fabricated via melt-blending, characterized thermally and rheologically, and tested in vitro and in vivo.
Result· AMP-PEEK composites exhibited enhanced apatite formation, pre-osteoblast function, and in vivo osseointegration compared to bare PEEK.
Validation· Validated using SBF immersion, mouse pre-osteoblast assays, and μ-CT/histology of rat femurs at 4 and 12 weeks.

Learning Search Space Partition for Black-box Optimization using Monte Carlo Tree Search

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark
Linnan Wang, Rodrigo Fonseca, Yuandong Tian arXiv preprint 2020-07-01 link
相关性: 该方法通过蒙特卡洛树学习搜索空间分区，可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵黑箱优化问题。
边界: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no uncertainty quantification.
动机· 高维黑箱优化面临维度灾难，现有方法样本效率低。
方法· 提出LA-MCTS，在线学习非线性搜索空间分区并利用局部模型选择候选点。
结果· 在通用黑箱优化和强化学习基准上，尤其高维问题，性能优于现有方法。
验证· 在多个合成和实际基准函数上测试，与BO、TuRBO等对比。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· High-dimensional black-box optimization suffers from the curse of dimensionality, limiting sample efficiency of global models like Bayesian Optimization.
Method· LA-MCTS learns a nonlinear partition of the search space online using Monte Carlo Tree Search and fits local models to select promising candidates.
Result· The method achieves strong performance on general black-box optimization and reinforcement learning benchmarks, especially for high-dimensional problems.
Validation· Validated on synthetic and real-world benchmark functions, comparing against Bayesian Optimization and TuRBO.

A surrogate model for computational homogenization of elastostatics at finite strain using high‐dimensional model representation‐based neural network

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark
Vien Minh Nguyen‐Thanh, Lu Trong Khiem Nguyen, Timon Rabczuk, Xiaoying Zhuang International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering 2020-07-01 10.1002/nme.6493
单位: Chair of Computational Science and Simulation Technology, Department of Mathematics and Physics Leibniz Universität Hannover Hannover Germany
通讯: Timon Rabczuk @ Institute of Research and Development Duy Tan University Da Nang Vietnam  |  Xiaoying Zhuang @ Chair of Computational Science and Simulation Technology, Department of Mathematics and Physics Leibniz Universität Hann
相关性: 该论文提出了一种基于HDMR神经网络的代理模型用于有限应变下的计算均质化，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的多尺度模拟加速。
边界: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific geometry; it focuses on computational homogenization of elastostatics at finite strain without uncertainty quantification or constraint handling.
动机· 加速有限应变下两尺度计算均质化，避免昂贵微观有限元求解
方法· 采用模仿高维模型表示的神经网络构建宏观能量密度代理模型
结果· 离线训练后在线计算效率显著提升，微观问题使用FFT方法避免固定点迭代
验证· 通过数值基准算例验证代理模型精度
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To accelerate two-scale computational homogenization of elastostatics at finite strains by replacing costly microscopic finite element solves with a surrogate model.
Method· A neural network architecture mimicking high-dimensional model representation (HDMR) is used to construct an explicit macroscopic energy density from microscopic boundary value problem data.
Result· The offline-trained surrogate enables efficient online macroscale finite element simulations, with microscopic equilibrium solved via an FFT-based collocation method that avoids fixed-point iteration.
Validation· Numerical benchmark examples demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed surrogate model.

动机· 高效量化结构模态振型的不确定性

Result· The proposed method accurately and efficiently predicts mode shape variation under structural uncertainty.

Mixed-Variable Bayesian Optimization

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
Erik Daxberger, Anastasia Makarova, Matteo Turchetta, Andreas Krause 2020-07-01 10.24963/ijcai.2020/365
单位: Department of Engineering, University of Cambridge
通讯: Erik Daxberger @ Department of Engineering, University of Cambridge
相关性: 该论文提出了一种处理混合变量和离散约束的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, biomechanics, or implant design; it focuses on hyperparameter tuning for machine learning models.
动机· 混合变量黑箱函数优化在工程中普遍存在，但现有贝叶斯优化方法无法处理离散约束。
方法· 提出MiVaBo算法，结合线性代理模型、特征表示和汤普森采样，并优化采集函数处理离散约束。
结果· 在多个超参数调优任务中，MiVaBo比现有方法样本效率显著更高。
验证· 在标准超参数调优基准上对比验证，包括深度生成模型调优。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Optimizing expensive black-box functions with mixed continuous and discrete inputs is pervasive in science and engineering, yet existing Bayesian optimization methods cannot handle discrete constraints.
Method· MiVaBo combines a linear surrogate model with expressive feature representations and Thompson sampling, and proposes an effective acquisition function optimization to handle complex discrete constraints.
Result· MiVaBo achieves significantly higher sample efficiency than state-of-the-art mixed-variable BO algorithms on several hyperparameter tuning tasks, including deep generative model tuning.
Validation· The method is validated on standard hyperparameter tuning benchmarks, demonstrating improved sample efficiency over baselines.

边界: This paper focuses on engine calibration rather than implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate modeling, and lacks biomedical context and structural mechanics validation.
动机· 减少发动机标定中昂贵仿真的评估次数，并处理实际测量噪声。
方法· 采用随机贝叶斯优化方法，对三个控制参数进行多目标优化，得到帕累托前沿。

Motivation· To reduce expensive function evaluations in engine calibration while accounting for real-world measurement noise.
Method· A stochastic Bayesian optimization approach is implemented for multi-objective optimization with constraints, calibrating three control parameters to obtain a Pareto front.
Result· Promising results are achieved at all noise levels, with optimal solutions near the true Pareto front.
Validation· Validation is performed through simulations at different noise levels to demonstrate algorithm effectiveness.

Uncertainty Quantification Neural Network from Similarity and Sensitivity

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
H M Dipu Kabir, Abbas Khosravi, Darius Nahavandi, Saeid Nahavandi 2020-07-01 10.1109/ijcnn48605.2020.9206746
单位: Institute for Intelligent Systems Research and Innovation (IISRI), Deakin University, Australia
通讯: H M Dipu Kabir @ Institute for Intelligent Systems Research and Innovation (IISRI), Deakin University, Australia
相关性: 该论文提出了一种基于相似性和灵敏度的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中的不确定性估计。
边界: This paper does not apply the UQ method to FEA surrogate modeling or biomedical implant design; it is validated on generic regression datasets without structural mechanics context.
动机· 现有基于相似性的不确定性量化方法易受无关事件影响，需要更鲁棒的UQ方法。
方法· 先训练点预测神经网络获取输入敏感性，基于敏感性设置参数范围，选择相似事件并训练边界校正网络。
结果· 提出的方法提供了公平且领域无关的不确定性边界，最终可直接用神经网络输出不确定性。
验证· 在多个基准数据集上验证，并与传统方法对比。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Similarity-based uncertainty quantification suffers from irrelevant events, motivating a more robust approach incorporating input sensitivity.
Method· A neural network is first trained for point prediction to obtain input sensitivity; then similar events are selected with adaptive ranges based on sensitivity, and a bound-correction network is trained to refine uncertainty bounds.
Result· The proposed method yields fair and domain-independent uncertainty bounds, and a final neural network can directly output these bounds without the full process.
Validation· The method is validated on multiple benchmark regression datasets, demonstrating improved uncertainty estimates over baseline similarity-based methods.
uncertainty quantification · 不确定性量化neural network · 神经网络similarity · 相似性sensitivity · 敏感性bound correction · 边界校正domain-independent · 领域无关

Motivation· To discuss anesthetic considerations for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis patients undergoing lower extremity orthopedic surgery.

Motivation· To determine whether chondrocytes from cam lesions in FAI patients are metabolically similar to healthy chondrocytes for potential autologous implantation.
Method· Chondrocytes were isolated from cam cartilage of 7 patients and compared with healthy porcine articular chondrocytes using mitochondrial stress testing.
Result· No significant differences in basal or maximal respiration were found between cam lesion chondrocytes and normal porcine chondrocytes.
Validation· In vitro mitochondrial respiration assays on human and porcine chondrocytes.

动机· 探究FAI与髋关节OA软骨基因表达差异的分子机制。

Motivation· To characterize molecular differences in articular cartilage gene expression between femoroacetabular impingement and end-stage hip osteoarthritis.
Method· Whole genome RNA sequencing was performed on cartilage samples from FAI and OA patients, followed by Ingenuity Pathway Analysis.
Result· 3531 differentially expressed genes were identified, with OA samples showing upregulation of catabolic and inflammatory genes, while FAI samples showed upregulation of chondroprotective genes.
Validation· No validation; only differential expression analysis based on sequencing data.
